query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Rust

on:
  merge_group:
    branches: ["master"]
  push:
    branches: ["master"]
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, synchronize, reopened, edited ]

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: read

concurrency:
  group: >
    ${{
      github.event_name == 'merge_group'
      && format('merge-group-{0}-rust', github.run_id)
      ||
        github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        && format('pr-{0}-rust', github.event.pull_request.number)
        || format('push-{0}-rust', github.ref)
    }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

  ASMFLAGS: -march=haswell
  CC: gcc-15
  CFLAGS: -march=haswell
  CXX: g++-15
  CXXFLAGS: -march=haswell
  RUSTFLAGS: -C target-cpu=haswell
  TRIEDB_TARGET: triedb_driver

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04-32

    container:
      image: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/builder:master
      options: --privileged
      credentials:
        username: ${{ github.actor }}
        password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - run: rustup toolchain install nightly-2025-12-09 --profile minimal --component rustfmt
      - run: rustup toolchain install 1.97.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --profile minimal --component clippy

      - name: Install cargo-binstall
        uses: cargo-bins/cargo-binstall@v1.15.7

      - name: Install tools
        run: cargo binstall --no-confirm cargo-shear cargo-sort

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Verify lockfile
        run: cargo update --workspace --locked

      - name: Format TOML
        run: cargo sort --workspace --grouped --check

      - name: Format
        run: cargo +nightly-2025-12-09 fmt --all --check

      - name: Lint unused dependencies (cargo-shear)
        run: cargo shear

      - name: Lint
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --
          -D clippy::suspicious
          -D clippy::style
          -D clippy::clone_on_copy
          -D clippy::redundant_clone
          -D clippy::iter_kv_map
          -D clippy::iter_nth
          -D clippy::unnecessary_cast
          -D clippy::filter_next
          -D clippy::needless_lifetimes
          -D clippy::useless_conversion
          -D clippy::useless_vec
          -D clippy::needless_question_mark
          -D clippy::bool_comparison
          -D unused_imports
          -D unused_parens
          -D deprecated
          -A clippy::type_complexity
          -A clippy::int_plus_one
          -A clippy::uninlined-format-args
          -A clippy::enum-variant-names
          -A clippy::mutable_key_type
          -A clippy::large_enum_variant
          -A clippy::doc-overindented-list-items

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cargo test --release --all-targets --all-features

      - name: Build docs
        run: cargo doc -p monad-event-ring -p monad-exec-events

      - name: Run doc tests
        run: cargo test --release --doc --all-features

      - name: Add WASM target
        run: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - name: Check WASM
        run: cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p monad-debugger

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
